recognize_zh: 一顆位於中央、核淡染而胞質邊界不清的巨噬細胞，被一圈胞質深藍、核圓而緻密的紅母細胞環繞，形成紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island），也就是「保母細胞」（nurse cell）。
features: Central macrophage with a pale pink, finely reticular nucleus and ill-defined pale cytoplasm
Rosette of about nine erythroblasts arranged around the macrophage
Erythroblasts with round, centrally placed nuclei with condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Erythroblasts adhere to the macrophage surface without intracytoplasmic engulfment
Background of red cells in a thick area and scattered isolated lymphocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (MGG) shows an erythroblastic island composed of a central macrophage with a pale, reticular nucleus and indistinct cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts. The erythroblasts show round nuclei with progressively condensed chromatin and are attached to, but not enclosed by, the macrophage. There is no dysplasia or hemophagocytosis evident in this field. Findings represent a normal erythroblastic island (nurse cell), in which the central macrophage supports erythroid maturation and iron transfer.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the cells lie within cytoplasmic phagosomes of the macrophage rather than arranged around its periphery.
Tumor clusters are cohesive cells with atypical, pleomorphic nuclei and no central macrophage, unlike maturing erythroblasts with uniform round nuclei.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell cluster around a macrophage
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, whereas erythroblasts have central round nuclei without a hof.
